item.title: Kacey Musgraves Takes the 2026 ACM Awards to the Country Mart for a ‘Dry Spell’
item.description:
[Intro music fades out]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we're diving into the latest news from the music scene. I've got a great story to share with you today. Kacey Musgraves just took the stage at the 2026 ACM Awards, and it was a performance to remember.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: Musgraves performed her song "Dry Spell" from her new album, Middle of Nowhere, which dropped on March 11. The stage was set up like a grocery store, and she rocked a stylish outfit, complete with a white tank top, Daisy Dukes, and strappy silver heels.
[Short clip of "Dry Spell" plays]
Host: The song has been gaining traction, reaching a high of No. 55 on the Billboard Hot 100. This is actually Musgraves' eighth song to chart on the all-genre tally.
[Soft music continues]
Host: Although she wasn't nominated for an ACM Award this year, Musgraves has had her share of success in the past. She won Album of the Year in 2019 for her album Golden Hour, which debuted and peaked at No. 4 on the Billboard 200 and stayed on the chart for 94 weeks.
[Soft music transitions to a gentle outro]
Host: The 2026 ACM Awards were hosted by Shania Twain, and it was her first time hosting the show. That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode.
[Outro music fades in]
